items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: Jerry Lopez has got a band and it’s Fat City Horns. And they are kicking.

ctx.x: Chuck Findley. Ray Triscari. You know those are guys that are all gone now but they were heavy, heavy duty players man. Today some of the guys in Tower of Power, they play really well. You know there’s — we have a band here in Vegas called — what the hell’s the name of it — Jerry Lopez has got a band and it’s Fat City Horns. And they are kicking. But that’s an incredible band. And the lead trumpet player in that is Danny Falcone who was a student of mine, and his father was the conductor for Sinatra for a lot
of years. And Danny’s playing lead on that and he’s playing incredibly well. So he would definitely be invited too.
